comparison.title: Home Assistant vs KNX and Loxone
comparison.subtitle: KNX and Loxone are industry benchmarks. Here's why we choose Home Assistant and how it differs from each.

vsKnx.title: vs KNX
vsKnx.intro: KNX is the European bus wiring standard. Reliable and robust, but Home Assistant adds an intelligence layer that KNX alone cannot provide.

brain.title: The brain, not just the wiring
brain.desc: KNX controls bus devices. Home Assistant integrates them and unifies HVAC, cameras, multiroom, voice and energy in a single system.

flexibility.title: Changes without rewiring
flexibility.desc: Modifying KNX requires ETS software and a certified programmer. With Home Assistant we adjust automations and scenes instantly.

ecosystem.title: No single-manufacturer dependency
ecosystem.desc: KNX ties you to bus-compatible devices. Home Assistant integrates KNX plus thousands of brands: Shelly, Sonos, Daikin, Apple, Google...

cost.title: Lower software cost
cost.desc: Home Assistant is open-source and free. KNX requires ETS licences and specific hardware with a significantly higher cost per point.

vsLoxone.title: vs Loxone
vsLoxone.intro: Loxone offers a simple all-in-one system. But its closed ecosystem has limits that Home Assistant removes entirely.

lockin.title: Zero vendor lock-in
lockin.desc: Loxone requires its Miniserver and own devices. With Home Assistant you choose whatever hardware you want and never depend on one manufacturer.

privacy.title: Real privacy, no mandatory cloud
privacy.desc: Loxone relies on its cloud for remote access and advanced features. Home Assistant runs 100% locally: your data never leaves your home.

custom.title: Unlimited customisation
custom.desc: Loxone dashboards and automations are limited to what the manufacturer allows. With Home Assistant we design bespoke interfaces and logic.

future.title: A system that evolves with you
future.desc: Loxone updates at its own pace. Home Assistant has a global community with new integrations every week and a future guaranteed by being open-source.

comparison.note: Already have KNX? We integrate it into Home Assistant without removing anything. Coming from Loxone? We'll migrate you to a freer, more powerful solution.

whyUs.title: Why trust us
whyUs.desc: We are Home Assistant specialists with a climate algorithm that has no rival. We don't install boxes — we design complete ecosystems where every degree matters.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: We answer the most common questions about home automation and our services in Madrid.

1.q: What is Home Assistant and why do you use it?
1.a: Home Assistant is the world's most advanced open-source home automation platform. We use it because it offers total control, privacy (everything runs locally), compatibility with thousands of devices and unlimited customisation. Unlike Alexa, Google Home or closed systems like Loxone, you don't depend on the cloud or a manufacturer.

2.q: How much does a home automation installation cost in Madrid?
2.a: It depends on size, systems to integrate and customisation level. A targeted automation can start from a few thousand euros; a full project in a large home can exceed €30,000. We always provide a detailed quote after the technical visit, with no obligation.

3.q: Can home automation be installed without renovation work?
3.a: In many cases yes, using wireless solutions. For more complete projects with structured cabling, DALI lighting or integrated HVAC, it's best during a renovation or new build. The result is more reliable and durable.

4.q: What makes your climate algorithm different?
4.a: Our climate algorithm is developed by us and integrated into Home Assistant. It anticipates needs based on schedules, occupancy and outdoor conditions. It manages zones independently and optimises consumption with a precision you won't find in standard thermostats or other installers.

5.q: Is Home Assistant better than KNX or Loxone?
5.a: They're complementary, not exclusive. KNX is excellent for bus wiring; we integrate it into Home Assistant to add intelligence. Compared to Loxone, Home Assistant offers more flexibility, no vendor lock-in and no cloud dependency. See our detailed comparison on the Home Assistant page.

6.q: Do you offer maintenance after installation?
6.a: Yes. We offer ongoing support, updates, expansions and issue resolution. Your system will always be up to date and running optimally.

7.q: Do you only work in Madrid?
7.a: Primarily in Madrid and surrounding areas. For larger projects we evaluate installations in other provinces across Spain.

8.q: Can I see the system before deciding?
8.a: Yes. We have a showroom by appointment where you can see real Home Assistant dashboards, HVAC, lighting and automations in action.
